title: Re: Following up on our pitch meeting
text:
Hi Lena,

Thanks for the follow-up, and for the kind words from your partners. Here are the numbers from the Westbrook beta so far:

- 214 students signed up, and 131 of them (61%) open the app at least once a week
- 58 study groups have been created, and 37 of them met at least twice
- After Westbrook, we plan to launch at Lakeside College in January and Crestview State in March. Tomás Rivera, our Westbrook campus ambassador, is helping us recruit ambassadors at both schools.

The public beta launches on November 2, so we'll have fresh numbers right after your October 30 meeting if that helps.

Let me know if your partners need anything else.

Best,
Maya Chen
Co-founder & CEO, Pairly

On Tue, Oct 13, 2026 10:37 PM, Wop testwell <woptestwell@gmail.com> wrote:

> Hi Wop,
>
> Thank you again to you and Maya for presenting Pairly to our partners at Harbor Seed Fund last week. The team really liked the idea of matching students by free time and study style, not just by course.
>
> Before we can move forward, our partners would like to see a few numbers:
> - How many students signed up for the Westbrook beta, and how many are active each week
> - How many study groups actually met in person or online at least twice
> - Your plan and timeline for the next two campuses after Westbrook
>
> If you can send these by the end of next week, I'll bring Pairly to our partner meeting on October 30.
>
> Best regards,
> Lena Fischer
> Principal, Harbor Seed Fund
>
